description: This file implements a caching resource class for Smarty that uses APC (Alternative PHP Cache) as the storage backend. It defines methods for reading, writing, deleting, and purging cache entries using APC functions.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Apc
classes.description: A cache resource class based on APC for Smarty's output caching system, extending the KeyValueStore cache resource.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that checks if APC is installed, throws an exception if not.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Fetches cache entries for a list of keys using APC's fetch capability.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores cache entries for a list of keys in APC with optional expiration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes cache entries for a list of keys from APC.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Clears all user cache entries in APC.
